description: Turn a reporting period into exact start and end dates and times in a time zone: "last month", "this quarter", "YTD", "MTD", "last 7 days", "next 2 weeks", "2026-Q3", "2026-W14". Optional comparison period (previous period, or same period last year), fiscal years starting in any month, and Monday, Sunday or Saturday week starts. Use for analytics queries, SQL date filters, reports and dashboards. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

as_of.description: Reference date or datetime. Default today

compare.description: Comparison range: previous_period (or to-date: same days into the previous unit), previous_year (weeks: 52 weeks back). yoy works

fiscal_year_start.description: Fiscal year's first month (1-12). FY named by its end year: start 7, FY2027 = Jul 2026-Jun 2027

include_today.description: End with today. Default true for *_to_date, false for last_N_*

period.description: today, yesterday, this/last/next week|month|quarter|half|year, mtd, qtd, ytd, last_N_days|weeks|months, next_N_..., 2026, 2026-H1, 2026-Q3, 2026-03, 2026-W14, 2026-03-15. Fiscal (needs fiscal_year_start): "this fiscal year", "fiscal ytd", FY2027, "Q2 FY2027". Spaces work. last_N_days = complete days before today

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC)

name: date_range

end_exclusive.description: Exclusive end; filter >= start and < end_exclusive

title: Reporting period to exact dates
